name: Zucchini

basicInfo.description: Zucchini is a fast-growing summer squash that produces abundantly. A few plants can provide enough harvests for a family, making it a favorite in home gardens.
whyGrow: Versatile in cooking: grilled, sautéed, baked, or in soups
Great value compared to store-bought zucchini
basicInfo.water: Keep soil evenly moist with deep watering 2–3 times a week

growingSteps: Sow seeds directly outdoors 2–3cm deep after frost has passed
Space plants widely to allow for spreading vines
Water regularly and mulch to retain soil moisture
Harvest zucchinis when 15–20cm long for best flavor and texture
Pick often to encourage continuous production

careCalendar.description: Plant seeds in warm, sunny soil.
Leave strongest plants spaced at least 90cm apart.
Apply mulch to retain moisture and prevent weeds.
Pick zucchinis when they are 15–20cm long.

symptoms: Dark, sunken spots on zucchini tips
Lots of flowers but no zucchinis

harvestingGuide: Harvest zucchinis when 15–20cm long for tender texture. Regular harvesting every few days encourages plants to keep producing throughout the season.
estimatedSavings: Growing zucchinis at home can save $60–90 per season, as plants are prolific and store-bought zucchinis can be expensive.
